svg.title: 15+ years of open Internet measurement: seven evidence streams, 2013 to 2026
svg.desc: A linked timeline of M-Lab's public measurement record. Seven horizontal clusters show how one open dataset has been reused for interconnection research, resilience monitoring, access policy, consumer protection, routing, protocol and platform evolution, and community-driven data reuse. Each milestone links to the underlying blog post. Marker shapes distinguish clusters. A bottom strip shows growth in test volume and global reach.
